rows.instrument: First, a case-specific motion to set aside under Neb.Rev.Stat.29-3005. After actual granting, separate sealing motion under29-3523(4); the adopted adult branch uses CC6:12 with CC6:12a instructions. Juvenile adjudication uses the referenced juvenile mechanism, not the adult form.

rows.destination: First-stage county, district or separate juvenile court in the county of conviction/adjudication. Second-stage sentencing court, using the actual granted29-3005order. A generic District Court-only caption is not sufficient for every case.
rows.trigger: After completion of sentence/disposition. For prostitution-related offenses, plead actual victim status at the time OR proximate cause; for other offenses, plead direct result OR proximate cause. Do not require government documentation; qualifying professional affidavit/sworn testimony can support the statutory status presumption, which does not establish every other element automatically.
rows.timingDeadline: Completion is the first-stage eligibility event;29-3005 adds no further multi-year waiting period or fixed outer deadline. Second-stage filing follows the granted set-aside. Neither statute supplies a generic clerk-response clock for the first motion; actual scheduling remains local.
rows.components: Supported first motion and participant account/evidence; optional request that any hearing on that motion be in camera; actual set-aside order before the second motion; correct adult/juvenile second-stage form and instructions. Preserve confidentiality distinctions: in-camera hearing does not seal every filed exhibit or make all later proceedings private.
rows.feesWaiver: Actual first/second-stage charges are not established in the retained track or this review. Fee relief is available in principle under25-2301.01, but a selected branch needs the actual applicable procedure/forms.
